title: Jorge Linares: ICE detains former Venezuelan boxing champion in Texas | CNN
text:
Source: CNN

Former Venezuelan boxing championJorge Linaresis in the custody ofUS Immigration and Customs Enforcementafter immigration authorities detained him Sunday in El Paso, Texas, according to Linares and his legal counsel.

“I’m being held by ICE in El Paso, Texas. What a crazy situation,” the former boxerwrote on X.

US Border Patrol agents and ICE officers arrested Linares at El Paso International Airport, an ICE spokesperson confirmed to CNN, describing him as “a foreign national in the country without legal immigration status, arriving from Venezuela.”

According to ICE, Linares entered the country October 26, 2023, on a permit for a temporary stay and “remained in the country beyond the authorized period.” He will remain in custody “pending deportation proceedings.”

Wilner & O’Reilly, the law firm representing Linares, confirmed his detention, saying ina statementhe “is authorized to be in the United States and has cooperated fully with immigration authorities.”

“We are in communication with ICE and are working to resolve this matter as quickly as possible. Immigration cases follow established procedures, and those procedures take time,” his lawyers added.

Born in Barinitas, Venezuela, the 41-year-old Linaresretired from boxingin 2023 following a distinguished career spanning more than two decades, during which he held world titles in the featherweight, super featherweight and lightweight divisions. A significant portion of his career was in Japan.

News of his detention emerged Monday. “I can confirm that my friend Jorge Linares, a former WBA world champion, is in ICE custody,” said Gilberto J. Mendoza, president of the World Boxing Association.

Mendoza noted Linares’ case is being handled by immigration attorneys and that he remains “in constant contact” with the athlete’s family.

“As president of the WBA, I will always support our champions — both inside and outside the ring. Stay strong, Jorge,” Mendoza added.
